prompt.alinti: Here are four free Claude plugins that kill AI sloth. The first one is called Humanizer. This thing has 45,000 stars on GitHub and it hunts for 33 specific patterns that are seen in AI writing. So whether that's like M dashes, the rule of three, or other small patterns that AI tends to do, it'll go and analyze it and strip all those out of the text. Number two is called Impeccable. This one has 61 different detector rules that work without LLMs. And so it uses those 60 rules to infer if it's written by AI or not, and you can apply it so it doesn't sound like AI when you're writing. Number three is 21st MCP. This is a real library of assets that your AI can research. So instead of your designs looking like generic AI, it can basically pull a good version of that from the database and put it into your project. The last one is Anthropics Very Own and it's called Claude Code Setup. It basically reads your entire code base and tells you which hooks, skills, and sub-agents you should be running. And the best part is all read-only, so it won't touch things. If you want all four of these for free, comment the word free and I'll send you the link directly.
